claim_under_test: the acquisition gap is concentrated in states the sensitivity band marks fragile (sets flag when the pick is not to be trusted)
rationale: Fragile states are mostly near-ties of the point values, and the already-seen decisiveness split showed only weak concentration (33.4% decisive vs 37.0% indecisive wrong). The band adds prior-overlap on top of the point margin, so I predict the direction holds but weakly: the band is a weak trust marker, not a reliable one.
falsified_if: fragile wrong-rate <= robust (no concentration), or concentration >= 15 points with AUC >= 0.75 (then the band is a strong marker and the claim is bigger than predicted)
